szenen.text: Trump blames voters for the stock market crash. Democrats want to stop new AI data centers. Who is right?
Thursday evening on Truth Social, Trump wrote: The stock market crashed today because the Dumocrats had a big Tuesday. So sad to see, you only have yourselves to blame.
Senator Bernie Sanders on X: National data center moratorium now. Americans don't want Big Tech oligarchs wrecking the environment.
On Thursday the Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day since April 2025. On Friday, chip stocks in Asia followed.
Bitcoin miners compete for the same power, and several now host AI. Next up is the jobs report. Pause the data centers or keep building? Comment below.
